note: Adapted from the new-species description of Sands 1965 (type locality Wenchi, Ghana), in English; the alate and the soldier are described, with no separate worker. The OCR mistook decimal points for colons or hyphens (0:85 is 0.85, "6:80-7:20" is 6.80—7.20), restored here by order of magnitude.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate differs from E. bipartitus in the almost effaced frontal mark and the shorter hind tibia; in E. convergens the frontal mark is distinct and the ocelli are smaller and farther from the eye, as also in E. abruptus; the soldier is closest to that of E. abruptus, differing only in the more abrupt descent behind the base of the nasus, while in E. convergens the nasus is stouter and the other species have fewer head setae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, with pale yellowish brown patches on the frons, the postclypeus and the antennae, labrum yellow; pronotum, meso- and metanotum brown, the remaining thoracic sclerites and the legs yellow; abdominal tergites brown, sternites brown at the sides and paler along the midline; wing membrane translucent, very pale brown, veins brown, the marginal area of the radial sector outlined in brown. Posterior margin of the head capsule behind the eyes rounded, less than a semicircle, slightly flared at the eye margin; frontal mark almost effaced, very indistinct, of indeterminate shape; compound eyes oval, hardly protruding from the sides of the head, rather large relative to the head width, eye width index 2.6—2.7; ocelli of moderate size, oval, separated from the compound eye by less than one fifth of their minimum diameter; postclypeus moderately inflated, about twice as wide as long, anterior margin slightly convex, posterior margin convex and rounded, very indistinct; antennae 15-segmented, segments II, IV and V subequal, III shorter. Measurements (2 individuals, 1 locality, mm): head width (across the eyes) 0.85—0.88; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.33; ocellus 0.10 × 0.14; ocellus to eye 0.02; pronotum width 0.69—0.71; pronotum length 0.50; hind tibia length 1.00—1.09; forewing length 6.80—7.20.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellow, nasus orange yellow to orange, the rest of the body wall pale yellow. Head capsule in frontal view distinctly constricted behind the antennae, the posterior margin evenly rounded; nasus narrow and columnar or slightly tapering towards the apex. In lateral view wavy, with a distinct boss at the base of the nasus, then nearly straight, with a weak concavity in front of the posterolateral lobes; antennal segments II, III and V subequal, IV shorter, the dorsal margin of the antennal socket often with a small ridge. The conspicuous head setae are 3—5 pairs (6—10 in all) in a transverse row at the constriction in front of the base of the nasus, and 3—5 pairs irregularly placed on the posterolateral lobes. Measurements (16 individuals, 4 localities, mm): head length (to the tip of the nasus) 1.20—1.35 (mean 1.29); head width 0.58—0.64 (mean 0.62); head capsule depth 0.38—0.43 (mean 0.41); pronotum width 0.31—0.35 (mean 0.34); pronotum length 0.11—0.13 (mean 0.12); hind tibia length 0.68—0.75 (mean 0.69).
